title: BetterArmorStands
body:
# 🦾 BetterArmorStands

**Give your armor stands real arms — and put anything in their hands.**

BetterArmorStands lets you spawn armor stands with arms, toggle arms on existing ones, and place any item — swords, signs, shields, and more — directly into their hands. Compatible with Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Bukkit and Folia on Minecraft 1.21–1.21.1.

---

## ✨ Features

- ✔ Spawn armor stands with arms instantly
- ✔ Toggle arms on any existing armor stand
- ✔ Place items into main hand or off hand via command
- ✔ **Sneak + Right-click** an armor stand to set the item in your hand directly
- ✔ Sneak + Attack to remove a stand
- ✔ Language support: **English** & **Deutsch** (config.yml)

---

## 🔧 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/bas info` | Show plugin info | `bas.info` | Everyone |
| `/bas spawn` | Spawn an armor stand with arms | `bas.spawn` | OP |
| `/bas arms` | Toggle arms on targeted stand | `bas.arms` | Everyone |
| `/bas item <hand\|offhand> <MATERIAL>` | Set item in hand | `bas.item` | OP |

Use `bas.*` to grant all permissions at once.

---

## ⚙️ Config

```yaml
# Available: en (English), de (Deutsch)
language: en
```

---
